name: "Freezer Friendly" Stuffed Shells with Cottage Cheese-Spinach Filling (Batch-Cooking)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe makes 2 (9 x 13-inch) baking pans of stuffed shells or 8 servings.

TO COOK THE PASTA: Fill a large pot two-thirds with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until almost cooked through, 8-9 minutes (the shells should be flexible but not completely cooked through). Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Transfer shells to a large paper towel-lined baking sheet pan and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp salt
454 g jumbo pasta shells

instructions.primary_message: FOR THE FILLING: Meanwhile, place spinach in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost.
Using your hands, squeeze as much water from the spinach as you can, then place in a large bowl.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 small pkg fresh basil
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add herbs to the bowl with the spinach.
Zest lemon into the bowl. Peel and mince garlic, then add to the bowl, along with Parmesan and spices. (Reserve lemon for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
6 clove garlic
2 cups Parmesan cheese, shredded
1 ¼ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp crushed red pepper
½ tsp nutmeg, ground

instructions.primary_message: Working in batches, place cottage cheese in a food processor and pulse until semi-smooth and creamy. Add to the bowl, then stir to combine the filling.
TO ASSEMBLE THE SHELLS: Divide marinara sauce between two 9 x 13-inch disposable foil pans, then spread out in an even layer.
Stuff each shell with about 2-3 tablespoons of filling, then arrange, filling side-up, in the pans (the shells should be tightly packed). Sprinkle with mozzarella.

STORING: Tightly cover each pan with aluminum foil, then wrap the whole pan with plastic wrap. Place in the freezer for up to 1 month. HEATING: For best results, thaw stuffed shells overnight, then remove plastic wrap. Place foil-covered pan(s) in a preheated 375°F oven and bake until filling is heated through and cheese is just melted, 50-60 minutes. Remove the foil and continue to bake until cheese is golden and bubbly, 10-15 minutes more. Remove from oven and let stand 5 minutes before enjoying! (If you'd prefer to bake after assembly, place shells in a preheated 375°F oven, covered with foil, for 50 minutes. Uncover and continue to bake until cheese is melted and bubbly, 10 minutes more.)
